safety_buffering.causal_weight: direct evidence server attached safety-buffering metadata; not evidence of execution stall

model_rerouted.origin: client comparison of requested model vs server-reported model
model_rerouted.reason_origin: client-synthesized unconditionally on any model mismatch in maybe_warn_on_server_model_mismatch
model_rerouted.causal_weight: proves model mismatch; reason is not a separately parsed server reason in this release

model_verification.causal_weight: direct server recommendation for additional verification; separate from buffering/reroute

cyber_policy.causal_weight: direct hard policy failure; not safety buffering

key_correction: HighRiskCyberActivity on model/rerouted is synthesized by the client from requested/server model mismatch in this release; safety-buffering use_cases/reasons are parsed from server Responses metadata.
owl_implication: Historical Owl screenshots establish visible safety-buffering UI, not model/rerouted, verification, hard cyber_policy, or a specific safety-buffering reason unless an independent captured payload shows it.
screenshot_limit: Generic safety-buffering banner does not expose use_cases/reasons; Owl screenshots alone cannot prove cyber/user_risk.
